# Generated files — never hand-edit

These files are produced by tools and overwritten. Editing them by hand is lost work and can corrupt state.

- **`apps/web/src/routeTree.gen.ts`** — generated by TanStack Router. To change routing, edit the files under `apps/web/src/routes/`; the tree regenerates on `pnpm dev:web` and build.
- **`packages/db/drizzle/**`** — generated by drizzle-kit. To change the schema, edit `packages/db/src/schema.ts`, then run `pnpm db:generate` and `pnpm db:migrate`. (See the `db-change` skill.)

Both are also Biome-ignored, so they won't be formatted. A `PreToolUse` hook (`.claude/hooks/protect-paths.sh`) blocks writes to them as a backstop.
